text.title: A Day by the River
lines: Last Saturday, we went to the river.
Ducks were swimming in the water, and a frog was sitting on a rock.
Then we walked to a big waterfall. It was very loud!
In the afternoon, Dad went fishing on the lake.

questions.q: What was sitting on a rock?
